annotations.title: Get one knowledge record by id

description: Returns one knowledge record's summary, by the numeric id a search_knowledge or get_by_name hit gave: title, a short excerpt in the source's words, the URL to cite, source, licence and date. A game-file record carries its build and says when player uploads confirm it. Use it to read one hit again by its id; for the whole text, call fetch with the same id as a string. An id no record has returns a null hit, not an error. Give field, a JSON pointer such as /questIds, to read one value of the record's data instead of the excerpt; an array comes in pages of up to 48 rows, and nextOffset says where the next page starts. A pointer that leads nowhere answers with the keys it could have used, not an error.

field.description: A JSON pointer into the record's data, such as /criteria or /reagents/0. Without it, the whole record.

id.description: The numeric id of a search_knowledge or get_by_name hit.

limit.description: Rows per answer, default and at most 48.

offset.description: Row to start at when the field is an array; default 0. Use nextOffset from the last answer.

name: get_entity

field.description: Present when field was given and found.

nextOffset.description: Present when more rows remain: pass it as offset.

value.description: The value at the pointer. An array is one page of up to 48 rows.

confirmed.description: Present when player uploads confirm this game-file entry (3 or more installs agree). asOf is the date the rollup was current.

extId.description: The source's own id, such as a wiki page title.

licence.description: The source's licence, such as CC-BY-SA-4.0.

snippet.description: A short excerpt, in the source's words.

sourceUrl.description: Where the record came from. Keep it with the text.

url.description: The record's page on everloot.app, absolute: an indexed lore page or a catalog page. Absent for a record the site has no page for.

keys.description: Present when field was given and not found: the keys of the deepest object the pointer reached. Empty when the record has no structured data.
